name: Aniimo: Season 1 - Departure with the Wind: Part 2
summary: Aniimo’s Season 1: Departure with the Wind Part 2 has arrived, introducing 32 new species and 51 new Aniimo, fresh storylines, and the Whisperwake Isles region, featuring Crescent Bay, Rosy Mirelands, Wildwater Gorge, and Cloudreach Falls. Players can discover new Prismana forms for Whirlbite, Gachapus, Jabster, and Sugartini, alongside seasonal additions such as Prismana Hypnyto, Prismana Ekrim, Hoptail, and the player-designed Jaguaraun. The update also adds permanent real-time 1v1 duels and a new fair-play PvP mode for Operation: Egg Heist, while limited-time activities include Aniimo Dash racing and new Dark, Earth, and Lightning stages in Holo-Battle Sim. Seasonal events include Night Parade, featuring decorating and fragrance-mixing activities; Magical Night, introducing special crops for your Home; and additional login, exploration, and photography events. Vein Abundance features weekly Prismana rotations, culminating in a Prismana Carnival.
